title: Set or clear one member's access rule for a scope (execute)
description: Step 2 of 2 for change a member's access rule. Verifies the confirmation_hash from -prepare and the literal "confirm" string typed by the user, then performs the action. ONLY call this after the user has explicitly typed "confirm" in chat. Original action: Sets the level one organization member gets for one scope. A member rule applies to that person only and wins over their role rules and the default. The scope is the project (`resource: project` with the project id as `resource_id`, level `none`, `member` or `admin`), a whole tool (`resource: dashboard`, level `none`, `viewer`, `editor` or `manager`), one object (add `resource_id`), or one property (`resource: property_definition`, level `none`, `read` or `read_write`). A project level of `none` blocks access to the project and its resources. A null `access_level` removes the member's rule, so they fall back to their role rules or the default. An empty result means the rule is cleared. When several people need the same change, prefer a role rule. Read access-control-members-list with `member_id` first and tell the user the current and new level before asking for confirmation. Requires human typed confirmation.

methodDocumentation.text: Set or clear one member's rule for a scope. A member rule applies to that person only and takes precedence over their role rules and the default. The scope is the project (`resource: project` with the project id as `resource_id`), a whole resource type, one object, or one property definition. A null `access_level` removes the rule. Returns the stored rule, or 204 with no body when the rule is cleared.
